description: Change a contract. Required: contract_id. Same optional fields as create_contract. Changing ends_on, notice_months, auto_renew or renew_months recalculates the derived deadlines; manually entered ones are never touched.

auto_renew.description: Whether the contract renews automatically when not terminated

contract_id.description: ID of the contract to change

contract_type.description: Contract type, e.g. rental, service, maintenance, lease, insurance, nda or other

counterparty_name.description: Name of the other contracting party

ends_on.description: End date of the contract term (ISO date); basis for derived deadlines

notice_months.description: Notice period in months before the term ends

our_role.description: Our side in the contract (customer, provider, landlord, tenant, partner, other); decides whom a notice period binds

reference.description: External reference or contract number; used for idempotent imports

renew_months.description: Length of each automatic renewal in months

source_root_id.description: ID of the source root folder

starts_on.description: Start date of the contract term (ISO date)

value_currency.description: Currency of the contract value, e.g. EUR or CHF

value_period.description: Period the value refers to, e.g. month, quarter, year or once

name: update_contract
